title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: dangerous-goods uplift left out of a disputed demurrage amount
content:
## Scope

Under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, this rule completes the amount a billed party disputes on a demurrage invoice line on the rate-misapplied or free-time-misapplied ground, where the container's booking may carry dangerous goods.

## Rule

1. The dangerous-goods uplift carried by the amount still open is passed through to the terminal and is left out of what the billed party disputes.
2. When the booking's cargo type is dangerous goods, the uplift share of the amount still open, which is that amount multiplied by the product's dangerous-goods uplift percentage and divided by the sum of 100 and that percentage, is left out of the dispute; otherwise nothing is left out.
3. The disputed amount is rounded to the nearest cent only at the end.

## In words

Disputed amount: the amount still open, less the uplift share where the booking carries dangerous goods, rounded to the nearest cent as the final step.

## Worked example (hypothetical amount still open of USD 780.00 and an illustrative uplift of 20 percent)

| Reading | Share left out | Disputed amount |
|---|---|---|
| Correct: the open amount multiplied by 20 and divided by 120 | USD 130.00 | USD 650.00 |
| Wrong: 20 percent of the open amount | USD 156.00 | USD 624.00 |
| Booking not carrying dangerous goods | nothing | USD 780.00 |

With an amount still open of USD 250.01 under the same illustrative uplift, the unrounded disputed figure is USD 208.341666 and it is rounded once to USD 208.34.
